description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog plugin for a textarea form element. It registers a dialog that manages textarea properties such as name, columns, rows, and default value, with functions for setup, commit, and dynamic content handling.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog by selecting the existing textarea element if present and setting up its content.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Creates or updates the textarea element in the editor based on dialog input.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Populates dialog fields with existing textarea element attributes.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Applies dialog field values to the textarea element.
